title: Migrate AI SDK Dart to Vercel AI SDK v7 — coordinated 2.0.0 release

commits.messageBody:
Introduce LanguageModelV3ReasoningEffort enum (providerDefault/none/
minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh) and an optional `reasoning` field on
LanguageModelV3CallOptions, mirroring the AI SDK v7 top-level `reasoning`
control. Additive and non-breaking: providers that do not support
reasoning ignore the field; provider-specific reasoning settings in
providerOptions take precedence.

First increment of the v6 -> v7 migration (spec layer).

…nAI (v7)

Thread the new top-level `reasoning` option through generateText and
streamText into LanguageModelV3CallOptions.reasoning, and map it to
OpenAI's native `reasoning_effort` in the request body. Provider-specific
reasoning settings in providerOptions still take precedence (v7 semantics);
`xhigh` is coerced to OpenAI's `high`.

Anthropic/Google reasoning mapping will land alongside the Anthropic
max_tokens fix in the provider-fixes phase.
